mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prescription (uuid, medical_record_id, patient_id, doctor_id, type, status) VALUES (#{uuid}, #{medicalRecordId}, #{patientId}, #{doctorId}, #{type}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE prescription SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS id, p.uuid AS uuid, p.type AS type, p.status AS status, p.create_time AS createTime, d.name AS doctorName FROM prescription p LEFT JOIN doctor d ON p.doctor_id = d.id WHERE p.medical_record_id = #{medicalRecordId} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.id AS id, p.uuid AS uuid, p.type AS type, p.status AS status, p.create_time AS createTime, d.name AS doctorName, pi.name AS patientName FROM prescription p LEFT JOIN doctor d ON p.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN patient_user_info pi ON p.patient_id = pi.id WHERE p.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{start}, #{length}
